content:
I ran a link check over every formal_proof tag in the repo last weekend.

487 links, 7 dead (six point at commits on a rebased fork and one at a deleted repo) and 3 where the anchor no longer lands on the theorem it claims. Issues are FC#5988 and FC#5989 and the third got fixed the same day. The script that finds them is FC#5995 and runs weekly in CI.

Happy to run it on anything else people want checked and if anyone has time to review the PR that would be great.
